thread:
Clara N: brainstorming: short, punchy webinar for product-led folks. working title: 'Inference Slate: What to ship first' key promise = 3 concrete configs you can copy + a 10-min live checklist demo.
Miguel V: love making it prescriptive. suggest we build a one-page cheat sheet (copyable JSON configs + routing rules). attendees should leave with something they can paste.
Priya S: suggested flow: 35m content + 10m open Q. keep demos reproducible (git repo + terraform snippets). speakers: Raj (runtime), Clara (product), and a PM from BetaCo if they can join.
Raj P: run-of-show draft:
```
00:00-03:00 Welcome + promise (host)
03:00-18:00 Three copyable configs (each 5min): low-latency, low-cost, hybrid
18:00-28:00 Live checklist demo: deploy a routing policy + inspect metrics (recorded fallback)
28:00-35:00 Customer quick case (2 slides)
35:00-45:00 Q&A + cheat sheet CTA
```
Clara N: we should gate the cheat sheet behind registration and ask for "one inference challenge" in the signup so workshop answers are relevant.
Miguel V: fallback plan: pre-record the checklist demo as a 6-minute clip and also export screenshots of the dashboard states. host will narrate if live demo chops. ops checklist: alt-region, backup recording, oncall eng (assign Raj).
Priya S: promo cadence: -21d announce + lead magnet (cheat sheet tease), -14d technical blog excerpt with sample config, -7d speaker Q&A post, day-of reminder. target CPL $45 via LinkedIn + community partners.
Raj P: metrics to display live: p95 latency, cost per 1k tokens, and success rate. keep visuals minimal (one chart per config).
Clara N: slides & assets ask: 6 slides for configs (2 each), 1 demo slide for checklist, 1 customer slide, 3 social blurbs. also short 20s speaker intros for promo.
Miguel V: rehearsal plan: full run 48h before (45m), tech check 1h before (20m). preflight: confirm repo access, confirm pre-record link, test playback on stage machine. deploy-bot: create invites for rehearsals and add reminders 48h and 30m.
deploy-bot: Reminder created: rehearsal invite set for T-48h and tech check T-1h.
Priya S: action items: Priya - landing + gating + email cadence (due Thu), Miguel - cheat-sheet repo + sample configs (due Fri), Raj - prepare demo + pre-record (due Fri), Clara - speaker outreach + host script (due Fri).
Clara N: copy variants for hero stat (will poll the team): "3 configs to ship inference features this week", "Ship reliable LLM features without overprovisioning", "Copy-paste routing policies that save 20-60%".
Raj P: need a short fallback script for the host if the live demo fails. I'll write it and drop in runbook.
Priya S: will set the registration form to require "inference challenge" text box. also threading the landing with an early access checklist download.
Miguel V: uploading a small repo with terraform + sample prompts. will add runbook with rollback commands.
Clara N: if everyone ok, i'll lock the date and start outreach post after copy lands. thanks all. :thumbsup:
Priya S: noted. locking deliverables and will ping if anything slips.
Clara N: closing thread
